sql: SELECT v.vendor_id, v.name, v.registry_id, v.bank_since, v.country, g.lei AS gleif_lei, g.legal_name AS gleif_name, g.country AS gleif_country, g.entity_status, g.registration_status, (SELECT count(*) FROM northwind_erp.payments p WHERE p.vendor_id = v.vendor_id) AS paid_count FROM northwind_erp.vendors v JOIN northwind_erp.invoices i ON i.vendor_id = v.vendor_id LEFT JOIN gleif.lei_entities g ON g.lei = v.registry_id WHERE i.invoice_id = 'INV0002'
